selection_window.note: Same as A2; no H2024 / no post_etf in selection

optimization_objective_declared.primary_for_C: Test whether calendar once-per-cycle full-exit + re-DCA structure remains comparable post-ETF — NOT maximize full-window ROI vs pure DCA

k_policy.meaning: K≤5 is an upper bound to prevent carrying the full exploration grid into C; it is not a quota to fill.

parameters_held_constant_across_set.r_selection_basis: Policy/mid-grid + contract BENCH_CAL_SIMPLE uses R=180; NOT chosen by maximizing A2 full-window ROI (that would pick R=365).

explicitly_not_frozen.X=450/630/900: Interior/weak on A2 grid; excluded to keep C interpretable

candidates.selection_reason: A2: X=540 is the only Exit on the contract grid that beat cycle-local pure DCA on both H2016 and H2020 with E=0. Carried to C as the cycle-structure probe — NOT as an adopted max-ROI rule. R=180 fixed (mid-grid / BENCH_CAL_SIMPLE), not R-optimized.
strengths: Both-cycle cycle-local outperformance vs segment pure DCA in A2 window
Clear once-per-cycle full-exit timing (dsh=540) aligned with strategy narrative
E=0 matches A2 dominance without delayed-entry complexity
weaknesses: Full-window ROI trails pure DCA substantially (A2 excess ≈ -609pp)
Long cash wait after each exit
X=540 near H2016 descriptive peak (~525d) — peak-proximity overfit concern
overfit_concerns: Do not interpret proximity to A1 peak days as validation
candidates.vs_pure_dca: Loses on full-window wealth path; wins on cycle-segment ROI at X=540
candidates.what_C_tests: Does the X=540 once-per-cycle exit+re-DCA structure remain timing-comparable and economically non-degraded post-ETF / into H2024 (without refit)?

candidates.selection_reason: A2 early-exit contrast on same E/R. Weaker cycle-local results than X=540 but still a valid full-exit regimen. Included so C does not only test the A2 'winner' X.
strengths: Earlier risk-off / shorter hold after halving
Still once-per-cycle full exit (not a hold proxy)
Controls for 'only X=540 was cherry-picked for C'
weaknesses: Worse A2 cycle-local and full-window metrics than X=540
Even longer cash wait in A2 (earlier exit → longer flat into next cycle)
May crystallize gains earlier (tax sensitivity later)
overfit_concerns: Not an A2 champion — present only as structural contrast
candidates.vs_pure_dca: Larger full-window shortfall than X=540 in A2
candidates.what_C_tests: If early calendar exits degrade differently post-ETF than X=540, the cycle pattern is X-sensitive rather than a generic full-exit effect.

candidates.selection_reason: A2 late-exit contrast. Closer to 'hold longer then exit once'. Poor A2 cycle-local H2020 ROI — useful degraded baseline for C comparison.
strengths: Shorter flat period after exit within-cycle path vs early X
Stress-tests whether 'almost hold' calendar exits behave differently post-ETF
weaknesses: Less distinctive as a cycle-timing strategy
overfit_concerns: Included for contrast breadth, not because A2 favored it
candidates.vs_pure_dca: Large full-window shortfall; weak cycle-local vs X=540
candidates.what_C_tests: Whether late exits look more 'comparable' to a hold path post-ETF, vs the X=540 cycle-timed exit.

prohibitions: Do not refit E/X/R on H2024 or post_etf
Do not treat this freeze as investment adoption
Do not interpret pure-DCA underperformance alone as strategy failure
Do not interpret cycle-local X=540 edge alone as adoption

sm_sot_alignment.human_decision: Adopt once_per_cycle into Strategy State Machine SoT
sm_sot_alignment.r_semantics: R_wait counts calendar days in the NEW cycle_id after transition; not from exit date. Frozen set uses R_wait=180.
